title: Utillian Ruby Pearl Pack
description:
The Utillian Ruby Pearl is a small, yet mighty component designed to revolutionize your concentrate vaping experience. Crafted with precision, this spinning ruby pearl moves freely within the heating chamber during inhalation, effectively stirring your concentrates. This dynamic action optimizes heat distribution and vaporization, resulting in smoother, more flavorful draws and minimizing wax pools and uneven heating.

Includes 5* Utillian 6 Ruby Pearls
